summary: This tutorial covers how to use Thunderbird on Ubuntu 12.04, focusing on adding a Thunderbird shortcut to the launcher, tagging emails, sorting messages by various criteria, and organizing them into threads. It explains how to drag and drop the Thunderbird icon onto the launcher and set up email accounts like Gmail. The tutorial demonstrates sorting emails alphabetically or by sender, using tags to mark important emails, and applying filters to view only tagged messages. It also shows how to display message threads for related conversations and print emails by saving them to a folder named "Saved Mails" on the desktop.
